user_authorization: 2026-09-29 explicit Reader and Judge both without JSON model output

prompts.reader_system:
Answer a question about the named people using the supplied memories.
Memories may describe either human speaker. Preserve attribution, negation, plans,
and changes over time. Observation dates date the conversation, not necessarily the
event. Combine complementary facts. For lists/counts include all supported relevant
items and avoid duplicates. Reasonable inferences must be grounded in the memories;
do not invent biographical events, dates, names, or links. If evidence is insufficient,
say so. Return only the shortest complete answer: a name, date, phrase, or list as
appropriate. Do not add explanation, background, introductory sentences, or related
but unasked facts. Do not shorten a required list by omitting its items.
Return only the plain-text answer.

selected_facts.reader_evidence_ids: local f1..f20 in input only; no model citation output required

response_policy.reader: keep exact nonempty text; do not json.loads or strip/rewrite answer
response_policy.judge: strip surrounding whitespace and accept only entire [[yes]] or [[no]]; other output technical failure

persistence_order: persist successful read_answer result and lexical metrics
persist judge success or technical failure independently
comparison_policy: Apply same version to every new compared arm. Historical65.639 is a separate old protocol; if its originalSDK20 bank is included, reuse fixed retrieval20 but regenerate Reader and Judge under this protocol.
notes: No newQA runner or new QA namespace has been launched.
An execution manifest must bind this protocol and all bank, selection, question and date sources.
Official LoCoMo F1 and custom token F1 remain separate; Judge failures must not silently change Reader/F1 denominator.
